result.description: A fictional countertop smart kettle designed for quiet kitchens, precise temperature control, and app-based scheduling. The Nautilus Echo 7L includes a stainless-steel interior, removable scale filter, keep-warm mode, and a detachable power base with 360-degree placement. It is intended for tea brewing and instant beverages rather than computing or storage use.
result.title: Nautilus Echo 7L Smart Kettle
